mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.title, t.completed, t.completed_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at, COUNT(ps.id) AS pomodoro_count FROM task t LEFT JOIN pomodoro_session ps ON ps.task_id = t.id AND ps.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.user_id, t.title, t.completed, t.completed_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at ORDER BY t.completed ASC, t.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (user_id, title, completed) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{completed})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
